tagline: A soft-knee compressor with VCA, FET and Opto timing modes
description: A stereo-linked peak compressor with threshold, ratio, soft knee, attack, release, makeup gain and a dry/wet mix for parallel compression. The VCA, FET and Opto modes only rescale the attack and release times; there is no saturation or other analog-modelling stage. Use it for general bus, drum or instrument compression.

features.name: Timing modes
features.description: VCA uses the attack and release as set, FET halves the attack and shortens release to 70%, and Opto doubles the attack and lengthens release to 150%.

features.name: Core controls
features.description: Threshold -60 to 0 dB, Ratio 1:1 to 20:1, Attack 0.1 to 100 ms and Release 10 to 1000 ms.

features.name: Soft knee
features.description: Knee from 0 to 12 dB eases the transition into compression around the threshold.

features.name: Makeup and mix
features.description: Makeup adds 0 to 24 dB after compression, and Mix (0 to 1) blends in the uncompressed signal for parallel compression.

features.name: Gain reduction meter
features.description: The editor shows the current gain reduction, detected from the louder of the two channels.
